title: Vendor Behavioral Fingerprint & Rapid Probe Matrix for Model Landscape
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: produce a reproducible 'vendor behavioral fingerprint' methodology and a rapid probe matrix to prioritize and execute short experiments against candidate model providers (hosted, dedicated, private). The deliverable will be a scored rubric + 10 probe templates that product, SRE, and solutions can run in a week to capture signals relevant to Redwood Inference: latency variability, cold/warm KV-cache behavior, token-cost sensitivity at different context windows, fallback degradation modes, observability gaps, and quantization quality regressions. This ticket scopes the PM work: define signal taxonomy, align scoring weights with commercial/operational impact, coordinate with Research for microbench workloads, and hand off templates to Eng + SRE for automation.
acceptance_criteria: Score rubric v1 with at least 8 signal dimensions (latency P90/P99, cold-start, token-cost, RAG coherence delta, batch throughput, error modes, region-resiliency, quantization sensitivity) reviewed and accepted by Research + SRE
Ten probe templates (1-2 page runbooks) covering short-context and long-context workloads, embeddings/regression, and quantization variants checked into the Signal Lab Drive folder
Automated probe harness story created in engineering backlog with clear API inputs and example datasets (PR or issue linked)
Executive one-pager summarizing top-5 vendor risk/opportunity profiles and recommended next actions for Dedicated/Private offering decisions
All artifacts have owners and a follow-up plan to convert high-value probes into repeatable telemetry ingestion (metrics + logs)
Pilot probes executed against at least 3 vendors with result summaries attached to this ticket
steps: Workshop with Research, SRE, and Solutions (week 1) to finalize signal taxonomy and weighting
Draft rubric and probe templates (PM), iterate with Research for microbench parameters
Define minimum dataset and prompt sets for reproducibility (privacy-safe synthetic variants)
Coordinate with Eng to scaffold a minimal harness (k6-like runner + Redwood API scenarios)
Run manual pilot probes across 3 vendors, capture telemetry and qualitative notes
Synthesize results into executive one-pager and recommend downstream integration (telemetry ingestion, scoring pipeline)
